description: This file declares the MessageDispatcher class, which implements the IMessageDispatcher interface and manages media key client interactions, including license requests and key status changes. It also defines an inner class for client management.

classes.name: MessageDispatcher
classes.description: Implements the IMessageDispatcher interface and manages media key clients, license requests, renewals, and key status changes.

classes.name: MessageDispatcher::MessageDispatcherClient
classes.description: Inner class that manages individual media key client instances, linking them to the main dispatcher.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a new IMessageDispatcherClient for the specified IMediaKeysClient.

methods.name: onLicenseRequest
methods.description: Handles license request messages for a given key session.

methods.name: onLicenseRenewal
methods.description: Handles license renewal messages for a given key session.

methods.name: onKeyStatusesChanged
methods.description: Handles updates to key statuses for a given key session.

methods.name: addClient
methods.description: Adds a media keys client to the internal set.

methods.name: removeClient
methods.description: Removes a media keys client from the internal set.
